segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, sensitive, acne-prone skin says the serum does not feel heavy or greasy and works well for her; another using it for oily-adjacent concerns notes she has no idea how it performs on oily skin since her own experience showed no greasiness at all.
segments.dry: Multiple reviewers with dry skin (including one specifically stating dry skin in winter) report the serum relieves flakiness and dryness and leaves skin moisturized and smooth, though one dry-skin user says it did not feel youthful or fully resolve lack of firmness.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin says it helped the dry, flaky areas without making the oilier areas greasy.
segments.sensitive: Many reviewers describe sensitive skin and mostly report no irritation, burning, or redness, calling it gentle and fragrance-free; however a few sensitive-skin users report irritation, stinging, temporary redness, or breakouts.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically frame themselves around mature/aging skin as a self-described skin type beyond mentioning fine lines as a concern.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers note smoother texture, firmer feel, or a slight reduction in fine lines over weeks; but multiple others explicitly say they saw no noticeable improvement in fine lines or wrinkles, or that anti-aging results take a couple of weeks to appear if at all.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers report visible and lasting hydration, softer and plumper skin the next morning, and skin no longer feeling dry or flaky; a small number say they didn't notice a hydration boost or needed to layer a separate moisturizer.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers who mention redness say it decreased or was not present after use, including with regular application; one reviewer specifically states no reduction in redness was noticed, and another reports temporary redness in sensitive areas that later subsided.
concerns.barrier: Numerous reviewers say the serum repaired or strengthened their skin barrier, especially after retinol/tretinoin use, leaving skin calmer and stronger overnight; no contrary reports on this specific point.
concerns.spots: A couple of reviewers report improvement in dark spots and marks; this is mentioned by only a small subset with no dissent recorded.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers with acne-prone skin report no new breakouts and even clearer skin over time; however one reviewer with sensitive skin reports the product made her break out badly, and another advises not using it during active breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers consistently describe the serum as non-greasy and lightweight, with several oily or combination-skin users confirming it does not add shine or heaviness; no negative reports on oiliness were found.

extraits.titre: Lasting hydration, but is it anti aging?
extraits.texte: I'll start off by sharing my favorite things about this product. The consistency is smooth and not greasy and does not leave a cakey feeling residue on my face when I go to sleep. It's a calming, hydrating serum that doesn't irritate my sensitive skin like many anti aging products do. I felt like it was a good moisturizing product but I can't say I noticed a huge difference in a reduction of fine lines and wrinkles.

I have been testing out this product for quite a while to gauge how I really feel about it because my skin can be quite sensitive. This product has a subtle moisturizing effect that isn't too strong to the point of causing bad breakouts. This product makes a good addition to your night time post shower routine, it does not burn when applying it, it does feel slightly tightening, but nothing harsh or drying. I would recommend it to my friends who experience sensitivity to harsh skincare products because this one was gentle enough for my skin to not cause any redness, burning or irritation, and that's very important to me.

extraits.titre: Great serum to add to routine
extraits.texte: I've really been enjoying this defense serum system! The PM formula is great and feels moisturizing on the skin without being sticky. I do use it with other skincare products such a hyaluronic acid lotion and it seems to play well with everything I've used so far. I have sensitive skin and did not experience any problems while using this serum. I have combination skin, so this really helped that dry flaky component without making me overly greasy. Great choice to add to any skincare routine looking for moisture and barrier protection!
